In article <33eb9i$abm@usenet.rpi.edu>, cleggp@marcus.its.rpi.edu (...Paul) writes:
|>
|> Oops!  Here's another short question I forgot.  The thing about transfers
|> in a "multiplayer game"...  Is two-players considered "mulitplayer" game?

Jyhad rules aside, you lose much of a multiplayer aspect with only two, and
sometimes three, players.  With four players, the social abilities of the
players kick in, and for many games (Jyhad, Cosmic Encounter, Diplomacy),
social skills are as integral to the game as deckbuilding skills.


Cedric.

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
"multiplayer" means "three or more players"...  at least that's what
how we use the term.  In a two-player game, everyone gets four transfers
from the very beginning.
